result.instructions: Tools for Time Doctor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who tracked the most hours in the Sales group last week?"; "Show the activity timeline for Maria on 2026-11-17."; "Which projects did the team log time to this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Time Doctor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timedoctor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timedoctor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timedoctor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timedoctor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timedoctor_whoami
tools.title: Show connected user and companies
tools.description: Show the connected Time Doctor user, their role and the companies this token can reach, with company ids. Call this first to get company ids. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/authorization.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_company_timezones
tools.title: List company timezones
tools.description: List the distinct IANA timezones used by the company's users. Use it to pick a reporting timezone. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/companies/{companyId}/timezones.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the company's users with their ids, names, roles and group assignments. Filter by group, manager or name. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/users.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tag.description: Group id, or comma-separated group ids (the Time Doctor 'tags').

manager.description: Manager user id. Returns only users this manager oversees.

name.description: Filter value for the user's name.

email.description: Filter value for the user's email.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user by id: profile, role and settings. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/users/{id}.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the company's groups (Time Doctor calls them tags), with their ids. Use the ids as `tag` in other tools. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tags.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_group

tools.description: Get one group (tag) by id, with its settings. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tags/{id}.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_projects

tools.description: List the company's projects with their ids. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/projects.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

name.description: Filter value for the project name.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally only those in some projects. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tasks.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

projects.description: Comma-separated project ids. Returns tasks of these projects only.

name.description: Filter value for the task name.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get one task by id. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tasks/{id}.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_worklog
tools.title: Get activity timeline
tools.description: Get the tracked activity intervals (the timeline) for users in a time range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/activity/worklog.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

user.description: User id, or comma-separated user ids. Omit for the connected user. Use `all` for company-wide totals where the tool allows it.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_time_summary
tools.title: Get tracked time summary
tools.description: Get totals of tracked time, idle time and related counts for users or groups in a range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.1/stats/total.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

user.description: User id, or comma-separated user ids. Omit for the connected user. Use `all` for company-wide totals where the tool allows it.

tag.description: Group id, or comma-separated group ids (the Time Doctor 'tags').

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Prague. Omit for the API default, UTC.

from.description: Range start (inclusive). The API default is 30 minutes before `to`.

to.description: Range end (exclusive). The API default is now.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_productivity_breakdown
tools.title: Get productivity breakdown
tools.description: Get tracked time per productivity category (productive, unproductive, neutral, unrated) for users or groups in a range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor's plan rules apply. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.1/stats/category.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

user.description: User id, or comma-separated user ids. Omit for the connected user. Use `all` for company-wide totals where the tool allows it.

tag.description: Group id, or comma-separated group ids (the Time Doctor 'tags').

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Prague. Omit for the API default, UTC.

from.description: Range start (inclusive). The API default is 30 minutes before `to`.

to.description: Range end (exclusive). The API default is now.

company.description: Company id from timedoctor_whoami (an id, never a name). Needed when the user belongs to several companies.

user.description: User id, or comma-separated user ids. Omit for the connected user. Use `all` for company-wide totals where the tool allows it.

approved.description: Only schedules with this approval state.
